[[UiTM F.C.|UiTM]] | attendance = 0 | average attendance = 0 | prevseason = [[2020 Malaysia Super League|2020]] | nextseason = [[2022 Malaysia Super League|2022]] | season = [[2021 in Malaysian football|2021]] }} The '''2021 Malaysia Super League''' ({{langx|ms|Liga Super Malaysia 2021}}), was the 18th season of the [[Malaysia Super League]], the top-tier professional [[association football|football]] league in Malaysia. The defending champions from the [[2020 Malaysia Super League]] season, [[Johor Darul Ta'zim F.C.|Johor Darul Ta'zim]], have managed to defend their title, securing their 8th consecutive title (since 2014) on 28 August 2021 although having 2 more matches left.{{cite web|title=Johor Darul Ta'zim win 8th consecutive Malaysia Super League title|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/johor-darul-tazim/story/4462870/johor-darul-tazim-win-8th-consecutive-malaysia-super-league-title|website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=27 August 2021 |date=17 September 2021}} On the other hand, [[Kedah Darul Aman F.C.|Kedah]] who became the runner-ups have qualified to the [[2022 AFC Cup]]. [[Penang F.C.|Penang]] who got third was a standby team for the AFC Cup and would qualify if the winners of the [[2021 Malaysia Cup]] went to the Johor or Kedah, but they failed to and [[Kuala Lumpur City F.C.|Kuala Lumpur City]] who became the champions ended up taking the spot.{{cite news |title=Kedah naib juara, Penang ketiga Liga Super |url=https://www.utusan.com.my/terkini/2021/09/kedah-naib-juara-penang-ketiga-liga-super/ |access-date=12 September 2021 |work=[[Utusan Malaysia]] |date=17 September 2021 |language=ms}} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To Malaysia Super League=== '''Promoted from [[2020 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[Penang F.C.|Penang]] * [[Kuala Lumpur City F.C.|Kuala Lumpur]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From Malaysia Super League=== '''Relegated to [[2021 Malaysia Premier League|Premier League]]''' * [[Royal Malaysia Police F.C.|PDRM]] '''Disbanded Team''' *[[FELDA United]] {{col-end}} '''Renamed/Rebranded Clubs''' * [[Kedah Football Association|Kedah FA]] separate and formed '''[[Kedah Darul Aman F.C.|Kedah Darul Aman FC]]''' * [[Football Association of Selangor|Selangor FA]] separate and formed '''[[Selangor F.C.|Selangor FC]] ''' * [[Kuala Lumpur Football Association|Kuala Lumpur FA]] separate and formed '''[[Kuala Lumpur City F.C.|Kuala Lumpur City FC]]''' * [[Melaka Football Association|Melaka United SA]] separate and formed '''[[Melaka United F.C.|Melaka United FC]]''' * [[Football Association Penang|Penang FA]] separate and formed '''[[Penang F.C.|Penang FC]]''' * [[Sabah Football Association|Sabah FA]] separate and formed '''[[Sabah F.C.
